anchors.label: Central campfire focal anchor
anchors.notes: Main visual focus. Good for warmth feedback and central attention; avoid covering flame with large pets or UI.

anchors.label: Foreground open clearing / pet stage
anchors.notes: Strong readable ground area around the fire glow. Candidate pet/state-symbol placement lane, but avoid direct flame overlap.

anchors.label: Left tent and care cluster
anchors.notes: Tent, crate, blanket, bedroll, and lantern already imply care/camp inventory. Good thematic care-prop area; visually busy for small labels.

anchors.label: Right stumps/table activity cluster
anchors.notes: Stump, table, bucket, bench, and logs imply interaction/activity. Good future action zone, moderate clutter.

anchors.label: Right sign and banner board
anchors.notes: Strong visual sign/notice anchor. Possible quest/status marker area; not a cutout sprite.

anchors.label: Upper sky and distant forest negative space
anchors.notes: Best broad negative-space candidate for overlays or atmospheric UI. Watch contrast near clouds and fireflies.

anchors.label: Left upper tree canopy
anchors.notes: Beautiful but busy/dark canopy. Better as atmosphere than placement; UI readability risk.

anchors.label: Right upper tree canopy
anchors.notes: Decorative canopy and tree trunk mass. Avoid small UI or tiny state icons here.

anchors.label: Left foreground mushrooms/shrubs
anchors.notes: Foreground foliage and mushrooms can obscure small pets/props. Good scenery, risky placement.

anchors.label: Right foreground rocks/leaves
anchors.notes: Foreground rocks and large leaves create strong occlusion/readability risk. Avoid primary interactions.

anchors.label: Left lower path entry
anchors.notes: Readable ground strip for entry/idle pet placement. Some foreground path texture but not too busy.

anchors.label: Right lower path entry
anchors.notes: Readable ground strip near stump/logs. Useful for pet placement if kept clear of bench/stump silhouettes.

anchors.label: Left lantern glow cluster
anchors.notes: Bright lantern and midground tree shapes can compete with small glowing icons.

anchors.label: Right lantern/banner glow cluster
anchors.notes: High contrast lantern/sign area. Good visual landmark, risky for tiny UI/status marks.
